headline: Linn Mercy Line Shifts; Colonials Gain Ground in Weathered Expanse
war_summary:
The Linn Mercy sector has changed hands in part since the last edition. Where the field there stood wholly Colonial, the Wardens now fly over three works against seven Colonial and one reduced to no-man's-land. Forty-two actions have been logged in the past day, the heaviest firing anywhere on the map, with the latest entered at this packet's cutoff and casualty tables climbing on both sides.

The Weathered Expanse has likewise shifted: five works now stand Colonial, one Warden and three unclaimed, against the four-two split reported earlier. Forty-five actions in the past day keep it the war's busiest ground. Callahan's Passage now returns all ten works as Warden, up from nine, and the Nevish Line has quieted after fifty-one actions on the day, holding at five Colonial works, two Warden and one unclaimed. Mooring County remains eleven Warden to one Colonial, with fresh activity at The Wind Hills. Marban Hollow stays near-even at four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed, its fighting renewed around Checkpoint Bua, while Stonecradle stands at eight Colonial works and one Warden. The map overall remains predominantly Colonial, with Warden strength massed in the north and west.
